summary: Design SSC processes, service catalogues, SLAs and dashboards through applied exercises. Explore the course and plan your next steps.
lede: Shared service centre design covers how to define service scope, ownership and measures when consolidating support work. For finance, HR, procurement and administration leaders, the practical task is to assess processes and plan a workable service model across teams. Participants map handoffs, draft service catalogues and SLAs, assign control responsibilities, shape performance dashboards and plan a staged transition.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for consolidating or improving finance, HR, procurement and administrative support. It suits leaders and practitioners who need to define service scope, clarify ownership, maintain controls and report whether a shared service centre is meeting agreed service levels.
modules: APQC Process Classification and Service Scope
prerequisites: Working familiarity with at least one finance, HR, procurement or administrative process is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
